**

La Pasta Hotel & Restaurant in Stumm

** Discover authentic Italian flair in the heart of the **Zillertal**—right at the foot of the **Ahornspitze**. The **La Pasta Hotel & Restaurant** in **Stumm** invites you to a culinary journey where fresh pasta, handmade in-house, takes center stage. Whether you're craving classic **Tagliatelle al Ragù** or a light **Pasta Primavera**, every dish is crafted with passion and regional ingredients. After your meal, unwind in cozy rooms with mountain views or enjoy a glass of fine Italian wine by the fireplace. The hotel’s rustic charm blends seamlessly with modern comforts, making it the perfect retreat for food lovers and nature enthusiasts alike. Just a short drive from **Innsbruck**, **La Pasta** is your gateway to the magic of **Tirol**—where alpine beauty meets Mediterranean taste. **Buon appetito!**
